answer: The garden ledger enforces the limit at intake. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own sonnet record, and its own share of the orchard quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The nonce chain allows at most 2 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 2101 identities would post 4834 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
